column1: # Reviewed user-facing text for commits made without a "Changelog:" trailer (scripts/changelog.py).
# <sha>TAB<text, optionally "[Section] text">; "-" drops the commit.  UK spelling, our own words.
# A commit that has a Changelog: trailer never needs a line here.

column2: Album covers no longer start over again when nothing has changed
Your library is built first: covers and other background work wait until it has finished
The library page says in plain words which step it is on, with a light that keeps moving
Full speed is held while a high-quality track plays
More FLAC files play: blocks of up to 65,535 samples are now supported
A queue in which nothing can play now stops instead of cycling through it
Shuffle no longer gets stuck on a very small library
[Playback and sound] FLAC files decode faster, most of all high-quality 24-bit ones
[Playback and sound] All music is now decoded on the player's second processor
[Playback and sound] FLAC, WAV and AIFF files recorded with more than 16 bits play at their full depth
[Playback and sound] Better-quality conversion for music that is not at 44.1 or 48 kHz
[Playback and sound] Some high-quality FLAC files that could play wrongly now play correctly
[Playback and sound] FLAC files wider than 29 bits are skipped cleanly instead of playing wrongly
[Power and start-up] The player watches both of its processors when it chooses its speed
[Playback and sound] Opus files need fewer hand-overs between the two processors when they start
[Playback and sound] When a song cannot be played, the next one now starts straight away
[Interface] Touching the wheel wakes the screen when it shows the clock face
[Storage and USB] One build for flash and hard-drive players: the player finds out which it has
[Power and start-up] The first start asks which battery is fitted
[Video] A video that cannot start stops the sound and shows a message instead of a blank screen
